external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app and receives a fax confirmation.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by customers to browse and place orders.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app, maintaining customer information and handing orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that receives dispatch notes and faxes customer confirmations.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation
processes.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: Flat file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Marketing spreadsheet containing the catalogue and macros.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: mobile app requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keep customers
data_flows.description: The web API keeps customer records in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card information

data_flows.name: hand order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
data_flows.data_description: Dispatch note containing customer name and address

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: Confirmation with customer name and address

data_flows.name: change catalogue
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: customer mobile device
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-controlled mobile-device zone containing the customer and mobile app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

trust_boundaries.name: Sokify
trust_boundaries.description: The Sokify-controlled system zone containing the web API, user database, SIMS, flat file, and fax gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office zone containing the marketing spreadsheet and its macros.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The web API is internet-facing because the system sells socks online and the mobile app communicates with it.
assumptions.basis: The description says Sokify sells socks online and that the mobile app talks to the web API.

assumptions.assumption: The customer and mobile app are in a customer-controlled device zone distinct from Sokify's systems.
assumptions.basis: The customer uses the mobile app, which is treated as running on the customer's mobile device.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app is in the customer-controlled device zone.
assumptions.basis: The app is described as a mobile app used by customers.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The text describes it as a mobile app and separately identifies the web API as the web-facing interface.

assumptions.assumption: The web API, user database, SIMS, flat file, and fax gateway are in the Sokify-controlled system zone.
assumptions.basis: These components are described as Sokify's internal order and dispatch components.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is in the Sokify-controlled system zone.
assumptions.basis: It is described as the database kept by the web API.

assumptions.assumption: SIMS is in the Sokify-controlled system zone.
assumptions.basis: It is described as 'our stock and inventory system'.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is in the Sokify-controlled system zone.
assumptions.basis: It is described as kept alongside SIMS.

assumptions.assumption: The fax gateway is in the Sokify-controlled system zone.
assumptions.basis: It is described as 'our fax gateway'.

assumptions.assumption: The user database contains confidential data because it contains customer personal information and payment-card information.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file contains confidential data because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents are delivery addresses.

assumptions.assumption: The marketing spreadsheet and its macros are in the office network zone.
assumptions.basis: The spreadsheet is stated to live on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet macros are in the office network zone.
assumptions.basis: The macros are stated to be in the spreadsheet, which lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet macros present a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: They are spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements, not a web application.

assumptions.assumption: SIMS presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a stock and inventory system rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The fax gateway presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a fax gateway.
